metadata.description: Short environment name: dev | staging | prod
Azure region for all resources
Region for AI resources. Some (e.g. Content Safety) are not offered in every region; centralindia lacks ContentSafety, so default these to a supported region.
Deploy the AI layer (Foundry/Search/DocIntel/ContentSafety). Turn off to bring up everything else first.
Deploy the networking hardening layer: VNet + subnets + NSGs + Private Endpoints, and VNet-inject the Container Apps env. Default OFF — dev stays public/flat.
Deploy the edge/ops hardening layer: Front Door + WAF, APIM, App Service portal host, and metric alerts. Default OFF for dev.
Container image references. CI overwrites the apps with the real ACR tags; the defaults let the first infra deploy succeed before any image exists.
Email for APIM publisher contact and metric-alert notifications (edge layer).
Resource name prefix, e.g. "expmgmt"
Object ID of the deploying user/SP, granted Key Vault admin for bootstrap
PostgreSQL administrator login
PostgreSQL administrator password
Chat model + version to deploy in Foundry (pin per SCOPING §11.2)
Embedding model + version to deploy in Foundry
VNet address space.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace to send container logs to
Customer (workspace) id of the Log Analytics workspace
Infrastructure subnet id for VNet-injection. Empty = public (non-hardened) env.
Storage account name (from storage module output).
Service Bus namespace name (from servicebus module output).
Key Vault name (from keyvault module output).
Container Registry name (from acr module output) — for AcrPull grants.
Whether the AI layer (Foundry/Search/DocIntel) was deployed — gates those grants.
AI resource names (from ai module). Ignored when deployAi is false.
Resource id of the Container Apps managed environment.
ACR login server, e.g. expmgmtdevacr.azurecr.io.
Resource id of the API user-assigned identity.
Client id of the API user-assigned identity (for Entra/MI SDK auth).
Resource id of the worker user-assigned identity.
Client id of the worker user-assigned identity.
API container image reference.
Worker container image reference (shared by both worker apps).
Port the API listens on (Dockerfile EXPOSE / $PORT default).
PostgreSQL FQDN (the API builds its DATABASE_URL from this).
PostgreSQL admin login (for the API DATABASE_URL).
PostgreSQL database name.
Key Vault URI (secret references resolve from here).
Application Insights connection string.
Service Bus fully-qualified namespace, e.g. expmgmt-dev-bus.servicebus.windows.net.
Blob storage endpoint.
Auth provider for the API (db | entra).
Resource id of the VNet (for DNS zone links).
Resource id of the private-endpoints subnet.
Names of the already-deployed resources to wire privately.
FQDN of the API container app to use as the Front Door origin.
Publisher email for the APIM instance.
Publisher organisation name.
Backend API base URL (the API container app FQDN), e.g. https://<app>.azurecontainerapps.io

properties.description: Default product for the Expense API with rate limiting and validation.

properties.value:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <rate-limit calls="300" renewal-period="60" />
    <check-header name="Content-Length" failed-check-httpcode="413" failed-check-error-message="Request too large" ignore-case="true">
      <value>0</value>
    </check-header>
    <validate-content unspecified-content-type-action="prevent" max-size="1048576" size-exceeded-action="prevent" errors-variable-name="requestBodyValidation" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
